description: Poraba električne energije večjih javnih odjemalcev v občini RENČE-VOGRSKO is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA RENČE - VOGRSKO. The database contains data on the electricity consumption of major public consumers. The structure is based on the FIWARE structure. Coverage: OBČINA RENČE - VOGRSKO. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity consumption of major public customers in the municipality of RENČE-VOGRSKO" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA RENČE - VOGRSKO. Its keywords include optimizacija objektov in naprav, energetska bilanca. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
